name: Crate
description: Crate downloads YouTube Music and Spotify playlists as auto-tagged MP3s via yt-dlp, enriches metadata with MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive, and delivers files directly into a Navidrome (or any folder-watching music server) library. Controlled via a Telegram bot or HTTP webhook.

notes.text: The LXC is pre-configured but requires the application code. Push it with: rsync -av --exclude='.git' /path/to/crate/ root@<LXC_IP>:/opt/crate/ then run: /opt/crate/venv/bin/pip install -e /opt/crate
Edit /opt/crate/.env with your TELEGRAM_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS, and Spotify credentials, then: systemctl start crate-bot crate-webhook
